event_data.context: Review caught unnecessary 48-bit timestamp overflow when a non-RFC cursor has room for a greater sequence at the same timestamp. The revised seed uses the first representable UUIDv7 sequence above the retained ID. Live regressions cover both low and high variants at the maximum timestamp.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
